title: Gloria was so...
text: Gloria was so knowledgeable about Gaudi. She pointed out so many details that the casual observer would miss. She answered all my questions. Th tour was an absolute delight.
author: Gayle_R

title: Cultural experience
text: Our guide was amazing and made our adventure a true cultural experience! I really learned many details that made these buildings so special. Well worth your time and effort!
author: Claudia_Q

title: Amazing private tour
text: Great experience with our private guide. His name is Miguel. He is very personable, nice and knowledgeable about his hometown, and Gaudi’s architecture. He explains in detail, in a passionate and inviting way. I fully recommend this experience particularly with Miguel.
author: lorenav417
